card.name: Start of unit and drug-name pieces
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a split-up term right before a following part: the 'd' or 'm' before 'L' in units like g/dL, mL/min, μ before L, and the 'c' in cobicistat.

modes.label: Lab units before L
modes.description: A unit is split so the marked piece comes just before 'L' (dL, mL, μL) after a number or slash.
modes.example: greater than 400 mg<</d>>L in older children

modes.label: Start of cobicistat
modes.description: The first letter of cobicistat after a comma in elvitegravir combination lists.

modes.label: Start of AML
modes.description: The first letter of the abbreviation AML after a disease descriptor.
modes.example: Relapsed or Refractory CD33-positive<< A>>ML (Single-agent Regimen)

card.writes: It promotes single-letter pieces such as T, g, d, p, L, which suggests it helps spell out the next short piece of a split term.
card.plain: It marks the opening piece of a split unit or drug name, like the d in dL or the c in cobicistat.
